title: sideritis arborescens subsp. antiatlantica
intro: Sideritis arborescens subsp. antiatlantica, commonly known as the Anti-Atlantic Tree Sideritis, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality, thanks to its therapeutic actions as a sedative and anxiolytic. The health benefits of Sideritis arborescens subsp. antiatlantica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
